title: TWICE Member Momo Wants To Collaborate With THIS Pop Icon | Korean News - News18
text: TWICE member Momo sent fans into a frenzy after revealing her dream collaboration. The K-pop girl group members Tzuyu, Jihyo, Momo, and Nayeon recently sat down for an interview, where they discussed their international achievements and opened up about the artists they hope to collaborate with in the future. Following their performance at Lollapalooza and the Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show last year, fans have been waiting for TWICE to collaborate with an international artist, and Momo’s revelation further heightened their anticipation. Momo Talks About Her Dream Collaboration During an interview with Hypebae, when the group was asked to reveal their dream collaboration, Momo replied, “I love Sabrina Carpenter. So I’d love for TWICE to collaborate with her. I’d also love to dance with EXO’s Kai someday." (TWICE’s Momo dream collab) TWICE and Sabrina Carpenter’s friendship goes way back. In 2023, the Manchild singer presented the K-pop group with the Breakthrough Artist Award at that year’s Billboard Women in Music Awards. While presenting the award, Carpenter gushed about her love for the girl group. “I’m obsessed with them. I’m just a really huge fan. They’re all so beautiful; they look like dolls. They are gorgeous," Carpenter told Billboard at that time. Recently, during Carpenter’s headlining set at Lollapalooza 2025, the pop star gave TWICE members Momo, Jihyo, and Sana a sweet shoutout by “arresting" them for being beautiful. The playful faux arrests were a nightly tradition on Carpenter’s Short n’ Sweet Tour, which had seen the Grammy winner give handcuffs to everyone from Millie Bobby Brown to Salma Hayek before performing her popular track Juno. What’s New With TWICE? When asked about their upcoming projects, Nayeon revealed 2026 is going to be a “busy year" for them. “We have a lot of touring planned for 2026, so I hope we’ll get to see each other often!" Momo told Hypebae. Jihyo added, “The one thing I can share right now is that it’s tour-related. Out of the six tours we’ve done over the past 10 years, this upcoming one will be the biggest yet!" Tzuyu, on the other hand, is working hard “to show you many different sides of myself, so please look forward to it and show lots of support!" TWICE will resume their This Is For World Tour in 2026 from January 9 with their North America leg. They will conclude the tour on June 4 with a power-packed performance in London.
